notes.title: Online mode available
notes.notes:
Great news! 

You can now play online with your Steam friends, by inviting them from within the game.
We've also taken the opportunity to revamp the game's graphics. 

We're also planning to add additional elements (levels, characters and objects). By the way, you can find : 

-1 level: Mandy's Web 

including a boss (Mandy Bulla), a henchman (spider) and a dream (canvas dream).

-1 character: Igor

His power pushes enemies in the same line or column one dream back.

-1 item: the spring fist 

the spring fist enable any character to repel an enemy around him.

The game is now in version 1.2, and we've got a lot of good things planned for the future! 
Thanks for your support, and enjoy!
